Amumu.summary: He is strong right now thanks to sustained burn damage from his items, so expect him to hit harder than he looks.

Belveth.summary: A truly even matchup. Play your normal game and focus on denying her objectives.

Brand.summary: Weaker than before but still a strong farmer. Build an early lead through ganks and mirror his pathing so he cannot take objectives.

Briar.summary: Easy, similar to fighting Master Yi. Dodge her E, which hits hard, and knock her up during her Q leap to cancel it.

Diana.summary: Still dangerous, but you are fine unless she lands her full combo. Use your ultimate to dodge hers or wait for her spells to be used before engaging.

Ekko.summary: His W bubble can negate your damage and let him burst you. His ultimate dodges yours, so do not use it early.

Elise.summary: Skill-based. Dodge her human E at all costs or you get one-shot, and remember her spider E lets her avoid your knock-up and ultimate.

Evelynn.summary: Your Tremor Sense gives you vision of her, but she still bursts hard. Shut her down early before she becomes a problem.

Fiddlesticks.summary: Buy Mercury's Treads to shorten his CC, and watch for his ultimate around objectives.

Gragas.summary: Nearly unplayable because his E body slam has no real counterplay. Avoid fighting him unless ahead, and do not overchase since he turns fights easily.

Graves.summary: His E grants Grit stacks that make him much tankier than his items suggest. Fight him when those stacks have run out.

Hecarim.summary: Fairly simple: knock up his engage with W to stop his damage. Do not try to W him during his ultimate.

Ivern.summary: His constant shields and CC are very frustrating, and Daisy is not to be underestimated. Mirror his pathing, since counter-ganks shut him down well.

JarvanIV.summary: A similar champion to Rek'Sai. You can knock up his E-Q combo with W; otherwise it comes down to skill.

Karthus.summary: Deny his ganks and plays by exploiting his lack of mobility; his damage is very high. Consider Mercury's Treads against AP-heavy teams, and invade him at Krugs on his first clear.

Khazix.summary: He can kite you and dodge much of your damage with stealth, but can still be burst down. Mostly a skill matchup.

Kindred.summary: She can kite you with high damage output. The matchup is about not letting her kite you to death.

LeeSin.summary: Knock up his Q or W attempts, then kill him, but watch for ward-hop jukes and respect his kick. With Goredrinker and Sterak's he outscales you.

Lillia.summary: Stridebreaker usually shuts her down by letting you catch her easily.

Maokai.summary: Watch out for his CC, but otherwise he is easy to kill. His saplings give him lots of vision control, so respect them.

MasterYi.summary: An easy matchup since Yi is weak right now and his early ganks are poor, giving you chances to get ahead. Avoid ulting him while his W is active.

Nidalee.summary: Depends heavily on her skill. Knock her up when she pounces onto you.

Nocturne.summary: A good Nocturne can block your W or ultimate with his spell shield. His fear can be dodged with your ultimate. He usually out-tanks you while still dealing big damage.

Nunu.summary: Comes down to your own knowledge; you need to win skirmishes. Do not start objectives when he is nearby, since his Q plus Smite steals easily.

Olaf.summary: His ultimate ignores your CC and lets him run you down, but he is only average right now.

Poppy.summary: Rare in the jungle, but her W blocks your tunnels and she can CC you until you die. Knock up her engage to stop the follow-up.

Rammus.summary: His updated kit has more CC, including a knock-up on his ultimate, and his high armor makes fights hard.

Rengar.summary: His W can negate much of your burst. Your W can knock him up mid-leap and cancel his attack damage.

Sejuani.summary: A standard tank matchup; do not let her kite you too much.

Shaco.summary: Your W reveals him, and he is weak right now, though buffs could change that.

Shyvana.summary: Once knocked up she has few defenses. AP builds still hit hard in dragon form; against AD Shyvana, let her ultimate onto you before using your knock-up.

Skarner.summary: He shuts down your engages well and his ultimate can set up a one-shot on squishy you. Respect his movement speed.

Taliyah.summary: Her E is a strong counter to your tunnels. She is squishy, so if you reach her you can burst her.

Udyr.summary: High speed and CC let him kite you. Do not try to one-shot a tanky Udyr; it will not work.

Vi.summary: A hard counter: her tanky build and CC shut down your engages. The author considers her worth banning right now.

Viego.summary: Good CC and damage but dies easily to a good catch. His passive possession invulnerability can block your ultimate.

Warwick.summary: His kit counters Rek'Sai, but he lacks the damage to exploit it in his current state.

XinZhao.summary: He has very long engages, protection and burst, and makes it hard for you to peel for your carries.

Zac.summary: You can knock him up at any point while he is airborne. Use that and fight him.

Zyra.summary: Squishy, but her plants clear camps and objectives very fast. Use your ultimate to dodge hers and avoid her biggest burst.
